name: An Noor
description: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth, and He guides whom He wills to His light.
summary: An Noor comes from Quran 24:35, which describes Allah as the Light of the heavens and the earth and speaks of His guiding to His light. The verse's imagery calls for reflection on guidance and illumination; it should not be reduced to a comparison with an ordinary created lamp or light.
